parole.significato: Any of various microcrystalline minerals, of light, translucent, or transparent appearance, which are easily cleft.
parole.testo: From Middle Low German spar, sper (“spar”); or from a backformation of sparstone (“spar”), from Middle English sparston (“gypsum, chalk”), from Old English spærstān (“gypsum”). Related to German Sparkalk (“plaster”), Old English spæren (“of plaster, of mortar”).
